objective: From existing public/Hugging Face sources, select, audit, and validate 3–5 20–90 minute long-video assets with genuine audio tracks; produce an exact, executable download list; and complete corresponding MVP data/protocol validation and a Go/No-Go record.
overall_reason: All 15 milestone requirements are supported by current authoritative evidence. Task 90 repaired the semantic metric and controller limitations found by Task 89, regenerated the complete Task 87 run, passed 441 tests, independently recomputed 72 metric rows, 40 aggregate rows and 72 final-point route certificates, and reproduced 13/13 selected artifact hashes. The milestone is proved as an engineering/protocol MVP; PROVISIONAL_SCIENTIFIC_INCONCLUSIVE is itself the completed and honest scientific Go/No-Go outcome, while FINAL_BENCHMARK_NOT_YET_VALIDATED remains explicit.
